scope: Three profiles × three rates, full-score threaded pools; exact raw PCM on eight buses against the original serial graph at the selected cadence. Fixed-1024 reference diagnostics retain subnormal-flush and propagated mix differences. Fixed-frame cancellation/lookahead rejection and short single-worker check. Consumer-paced, no real-time performance claim.

rows.comparisonPolicy: Primary check: exact raw sample values against the original serial graph at the selected block cadence. A separate fixed-1024-frame reference retains all cross-cadence differences, including subnormal boundary flushing and propagated mix residuals. No amplitude tolerance or DSP/golden change.
